_comment: Template for content/<slug>/script.json — stage 1 output. Fields: timestamp_start/audio_dur_s are FILLED BY THE VO STAGE (real measurements, rule V1); draft with 0.0 and update after vo_pipeline. fact_sources REQUIRED on every line (rule S7). sfx.at = final-timeline seconds. Copy from the newest exemplar (content/short-0004/script.json) when in doubt.
title: Why is the sky blue? (It's not the ocean)

hook.narration: ONE breath: the question names the topic (rule S3) + the promised subversion. ≤14 words (rule S2).

visual.pose: pose-name from your POSES table (rule C4: no adjacent repeats)
visual.prop: the premise visual, on screen at t=0 — never a caption

fact_sources: source for any checkable claim — URL or named reference

scenes.narration: Scene line. Short declaratives mixed with flowing ones (rule S8).
